english: ah (softening particle at end of sentence)
breakdown: 口(mouth)+阿(sound 'a') — a mouth making the sound 'a'

examples.py: Shì a, wǒ yě zhème xiǎng.

examples.en: How come you only got here now?

english: auntie; a woman of your mother's age
breakdown: 阿(prefix for people)+姨(mother's sister)

examples.cn: 这位阿姨是我妈妈的朋友。
examples.py: Zhè wèi āyí shì wǒ māma de péngyou.
examples.en: This lady is my mom's friend.
The auntie comes to clean the room every day.

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng āyí bāng ge máng.
examples.en: I want to ask auntie for a favor.

examples.py: Āyí zuò de cài hěn hǎochī.
examples.en: The food auntie makes is delicious.

breakdown: 矢(arrow)+委 — think of a short arrow

examples.py: Zhè kē shù tài ǎi le.
Wǒ bǐ wǒ gēge ǎi yìdiǎnr.
examples.en: I am a little shorter than my older brother.
This table is a bit low.

examples.cn: 他小时候很矮，现在很高。
examples.py: Tā xiǎoshíhou hěn ǎi, xiànzài hěn gāo.
examples.en: He was short as a child, now he is tall.

khmer: ចំណង់ចំណូលចិត្ត
breakdown: 爱(love)+好(like) — what you love and like doing

examples.py: Wǒ de àihào shì kàn shū.
Dǎ qiú shì wǒ zuì dà de àihào.
examples.en: Playing ball is my biggest hobby.

breakdown: 安(safe, calm)+静(still) — calm and still

examples.cn: 这个地方又安静又干净。
examples.py: Zhège dìfang yòu ānjìng yòu gānjìng.
examples.en: This place is both quiet and clean.

english: to move (something heavy); to move house
khmer: ផ្លាស់ទី / លីក
breakdown: 扌(hand radical)+般 — hands moving something

examples.py: Wǒ xià ge yuè bān jiā.
examples.en: I am moving house next month.
Please help me move the table.

examples.cn: 这个箱子太重，我搬不动。
examples.py: Zhège xiāngzi tài zhòng, wǒ bān bu dòng.
examples.en: This box is too heavy, I can't move it.

examples.py: Tāmen bān dào Běijīng qù le.

breakdown: 两个王(jade)+刂(knife) — originally splitting jade, now a split group

examples.py: Wǒmen bān yǒu èrshí ge xuésheng.
Tā shì wǒmen bān de bānzhǎng.
Wǒmen bān de chéngjì hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Our class's results are very good.

examples.py: Quán bān tóngxué dōu lái le.

khmer: ពាក់កណ្ដាល
breakdown: 八(split into two)+牛(ox) — an ox split in two

examples.py: Wǒ děng le bàn ge xiǎoshí.
Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le yíbàn.
examples.en: I've read half of this book.

examples.py: Bàn nián yǐhòu tā jiù huílái le.
examples.en: He came back after half a year.

breakdown: 办(handle, do)+法(method) — a way of handling things

examples.en: I have no way / I can't help it.
We need to think of a way.

examples.py: Nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ ma?
examples.en: Do you have any good ideas?

breakdown: 办(handle)+公(public, official)+室(room) — the room for official work

examples.en: The teacher is in the office.

examples.py: Wǒmen de bàngōngshì zài sān lóu.
examples.en: Our office is on the third floor.

examples.py: Bàngōngshì lǐ yǒu wǔ ge rén.
examples.en: There are five people in the office.
He went to the office for a meeting.

english: to help; to lend a hand
breakdown: 帮(help)+忙(busy) — help someone who is busy

examples.py: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ yí ge máng ma?
examples.en: Can you do me a favor?

examples.py: Tā chángcháng bāng māma de máng.

examples.cn: 大家一起帮忙，很快就做完了。
examples.py: Dàjiā yìqǐ bāngmáng, hěn kuài jiù zuò wán le.
examples.en: Everyone helped together, so it was done quickly.

khmer: កាបូប / ខ្ចប់
breakdown: 勹(wrap)+巳 — something wrapped up

examples.py: Tā mǎi le yí ge xīn bāo.
Wǒ de shū dōu zài bāo lǐ.
examples.en: All my books are in the bag.
Please wrap it up for me.

breakdown: 饣(food radical)+包(sound bāo) — food + the 'bao' sound

examples.py: Zhèxiē cài gòu wǒmen chī bǎo le.
examples.en: This food is enough to fill us up.

examples.py: Chī bǎo le cái yǒu lìqi xuéxí.
examples.en: Only when you're full do you have energy to study.

khmer: ដោយ (ទម្រង់អកម្ម)
breakdown: 衤(clothing radical)+皮(skin) — cloth over you; also the passive marker

examples.py: Wǒ de chē bèi rén kāi zǒu le.
examples.en: My car was driven away by someone.

examples.py: Dàngāo bèi dìdi chī wán le.
examples.en: The cake was eaten up by my little brother.

examples.py: Tā bèi lǎoshī jiào dào bàngōngshì.
examples.en: He was called to the office by the teacher.

examples.py: Zhè běn shū bèi jiè zǒu le.
Tiān lěng le, qǐng duō gài yì chuáng bèi.
examples.en: It's cold, please use one more quilt.

breakdown: 北(north)+方(direction) — the north direction

examples.en: Winter in the north is very cold.
I have never been to the north.

examples.cn: 从北方到南方要坐飞机。
examples.py: Cóng běifāng dào nánfāng yào zuò fēijī.
examples.en: From the north to the south you need to fly.

khmer: សៀវភៅកត់ត្រា
breakdown: 笔(pen)+记(record)+本(book) — a book to write records in

examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng ge bǐjìběn.
Wǒ de bǐjìběn zhǎo bu dào le.

examples.cn: 他在笔记本上写了很多。
examples.py: Tā zài bǐjìběn shàng xiě le hěn duō.
examples.en: He wrote a lot in his notebook.

khmer: ប្រៀបធៀប / ស្មើៗ
breakdown: 比(compare)+较(compare) — two compare characters together

examples.py: Qǐng bǐjiào zhè liǎng ge cí.

breakdown: 比(compare)+赛(contest) — comparing who is better

examples.en: Are you taking part in the competition?

examples.py: Zhè chǎng bǐsài hěn yǒu yìsi.

examples.en: The match starts at three in the afternoon.

breakdown: 必(certainly)+须(need) — certainly need to

examples.py: Xuésheng bìxū bā diǎn dào jiàoshì.
examples.en: Students must arrive at the classroom at eight.

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì bìxū jīntiān zuò wán.

examples.en: You must rest a bit first.

breakdown: 鼻(nose)+子(noun suffix)

examples.py: Xiǎo gǒu de bízi hěn líng.
examples.en: A dog's nose is very sharp.

examples.py: Tiān lěng de shíhou bízi huì hóng.
examples.en: When it's cold the nose turns red.
Please breathe slowly through your nose.

khmer: ការផ្លាស់ប្ដូរ
breakdown: 变(change)+化(transform) — two change characters together

examples.en: There have been big changes here.

examples.py: Wǒ kàn dào le tā de biànhuà.
examples.en: I saw the change in him.

examples.cn: 这几年城市变化了很多。
examples.py: Zhè jǐ nián chéngshì biànhuà le hěn duō.
examples.en: The city has changed a lot these few years.
There is a small change to the plan.

breakdown: 别(other)+人(person) — other persons

examples.py: Biéren bù zhīdào zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: Other people don't know about this.

examples.py: Bú yào shuō biéren de huàihuà.

breakdown: 冰(ice)+箱(box) — an ice box

examples.en: The milk is in the fridge.

examples.py: Wǒ jiā de bīngxiāng hěn dà.
examples.en: My family's fridge is very big.

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ shuǐguǒ fàng jìn bīngxiāng.
examples.en: Please put the fruit in the fridge.
There's nothing left in the fridge.

examples.py: Zhège bīngxiāng shì xīn mǎi de.

khmer: បញ្ជីមុខម្ហូប
breakdown: 菜(dish)+单(list) — a list of dishes

examples.py: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de càidān hěn cháng.
examples.en: This restaurant's menu is very long.

examples.py: Wǒ kàn bu dǒng Zhōngwén càidān.
examples.en: I can't read a Chinese menu.
There are pictures on the menu.

breakdown: 参(participate)+加(add) — add yourself in

examples.en: I want to take part in the competition.

examples.py: Hěn duō rén cānjiā le zhège huì.

examples.en: He has no time to take part.

breakdown: 艹(grass radical)+早(sound zǎo) — plants + the 'cao/zao' sound

examples.py: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō cǎo.
examples.en: There is a lot of grass in the park.
The children are playing on the grass.

examples.py: Chūntiān cǎo zhǎng de hěn kuài.
Qǐng bú yào zǒu zài cǎo shàng.
examples.en: Please don't walk on the grass.

breakdown: 尸(roof shape)+云(cloud) — layers stacked up

examples.en: I live on the third floor.
Which floor is the office on?

examples.py: Shàng yì céng yǒu ge chāoshì.
examples.en: There is a supermarket one floor up.

examples.py: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì céng shuǐ.
examples.en: There is a layer of water on the table.

english: to lack; poor (in quality); short of
khmer: ខ្វះ / មិនល្អ
breakdown: Whole shape — no reliable split

examples.py: Xiànzài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn.

examples.cn: 这个饭店的服务太差了。
examples.py: Zhège fàndiàn de fúwù tài chà le.
examples.en: This restaurant's service is too poor.

examples.py: Wǒ chà yìdiǎnr jiù chídào le.

khmer: ផ្សារទំនើប
breakdown: 超(super)+市(market) — super market

examples.en: I'm going to the supermarket to buy things.
The supermarket is right next door.
What time does the supermarket close?

examples.py: Chāoshì lǐ de shuǐguǒ hěn xīnxiān.
examples.en: The fruit in the supermarket is very fresh.

breakdown: 衬(lining, 衤clothing radical)+衫(shirt, 衤clothing radical) — both have the clothing radical

examples.py: Wǒ mǎi le yí jiàn bái chènshān.
Tā de chènshān shì xīn de.
Zhè jiàn chènshān tài xiǎo le.

examples.en: You should wear a shirt for the meeting.

khmer: លទ្ធផល / ពិន្ទុ
breakdown: 成(become, succeed)+绩(achievement) — what you achieved

examples.en: The exam results come out tomorrow.

examples.py: Tā de chéngjì bǐ wǒ hǎo.
examples.en: His grades are better than mine.

examples.py: Nǔlì xuéxí cái yǒu hǎo chéngjì.
examples.en: Only by studying hard do you get good grades.

examples.cn: 老师说我的成绩有变化。
examples.py: Lǎoshī shuō wǒ de chéngjì yǒu biànhuà.
examples.en: The teacher said my grades have changed.

breakdown: 城(city wall)+市(market) — a walled place with a market

examples.en: There are many people in the city.
He comes from a small city.
This city has changed a lot.

breakdown: 迟(late)+到(arrive) — arrive late

examples.en: He is often late for class.

examples.py: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, wǒ chídào le.
examples.en: Because it rained, I was late.

examples.py: Chídào de rén yào shuō duìbuqǐ.
examples.en: People who are late should say sorry.

breakdown: 除(remove)+了(particle) — take it out of the group

examples.py: Chúle wǒ, dàjiā dōu qù le.
Chúle Hànyǔ, tā hái huì Yīngyǔ.
examples.en: Besides Chinese, he also knows English.

examples.cn: 除了星期天，我每天上班。
examples.en: Except Sunday, I work every day.

examples.py: Chúle tā yǐwài, méi rén zhīdào.
Chúle chá, wǒ shénme dōu bù hē.
examples.en: Apart from tea, I don't drink anything.

breakdown: 舟(boat radical)+铅(sound clue) — the boat radical gives the meaning

examples.py: Zuò chuán bǐ zuò fēijī màn.
examples.en: Going by boat is slower than by plane.

examples.py: Chuán shàng yǒu hěn duō rén.
examples.en: There are many people on the boat.
What time does the boat leave?

breakdown: Top part + 日(sun) — the sun getting warmer

examples.en: The weather in spring is very nice.

khmer: វចនានុក្រម
breakdown: 词(word)+典(standard book) — a standard book of words

examples.py: Qǐng jiè wǒ yì běn cídiǎn.

examples.en: I use a dictionary to look up new words.

examples.py: Xiànzài shǒujī shàng yě yǒu cídiǎn.
examples.en: Now there are dictionaries on phones too.

breakdown: 聪(good hearing, 耳ear radical)+明(bright) — sharp ears and a bright mind

examples.py: Cōngming de rén yě yào nǔlì.
examples.en: Clever people also need to work hard.

examples.cn: 你想的这个办法很聪明。
examples.py: Nǐ xiǎng de zhège bànfǎ hěn cōngming.
examples.en: The method you thought of is very clever.

breakdown: 打(do, hit, 扌hand)+扫(sweep, 扌hand) — both use the hand radical

examples.en: I need to clean the room.

examples.py: Dǎsǎo wán le, fángjiān hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: After cleaning, the room is very clean.

examples.py: Měi ge xīngqītiān wǒ dōu dǎsǎo.

breakdown: 打(do)+算(calculate) — work out what you will do

examples.en: What do you plan to do?
I plan to go to China.
We plan to take part in the competition.

breakdown: 蛋(egg)+糕(cake, 米rice radical) — made from eggs and flour

examples.en: You eat cake on your birthday.

examples.py: Māma zuò le yí ge dà dàngāo.

examples.en: The cake is in the fridge.

breakdown: 担(carry on a shoulder)+心(heart) — carrying something heavy on your heart

examples.en: Mom worries about me a lot.

examples.py: Nǐ búyòng dānxīn, wǒ méi shì.
examples.en: You don't need to worry, I'm fine.
He worries he will be late.

breakdown: 当(ought to be)+然(so) — it ought to be so

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì dāngrán hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: This matter is of course very important.

examples.py: Dāngrán, wǒ huì bāng nǐ de.
examples.en: Of course, I will help you.

khmer: ដោយ (បច្ច័យគុណកិរិយា)
breakdown: 土(earth)+也(sound yě) — read 'de' as a grammar particle, 'dì' as ground

examples.py: Wǒ rènzhēn de zhǔnbèi le kǎoshì.
examples.en: I prepared for the exam seriously.

examples.py: Tā kuàikuài de chī wán le fàn.

breakdown: 火(fire radical)+丁(sound dīng) — fire gives the meaning, 丁 gives the sound

examples.py: Fángjiān lǐ yǒu liǎng ge dēng.
examples.en: There are two lights in the room.

examples.py: Zǒu de shíhou qǐng guān dēng.
examples.en: Please turn off the light when you leave.

breakdown: 地(ground, earth)+方(area, direction) — an area of ground

examples.en: What places have you been to?

examples.py: Wǒ zhǎo bu dào nàge dìfang.

examples.cn: 这里是我最喜欢的地方。
examples.py: Zhèlǐ shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de dìfang.

examples.cn: 那个地方又安静又干净。
examples.py: Nàge dìfang yòu ānjìng yòu gānjìng.
examples.en: That place is both quiet and clean.
